source.author: cic
source.text: silent enim leges inter arma nec se exspectari iubent, cum ei qui exspectare velit ante iniusta poena luenda sit quam iusta repetenda.
source.text_original: silent enim leges inter arma nec se exspectari iubent, cum ei qui exspectare velit ante iniusta poena luenda sit quam iusta repetenda.
source.text_english: For the laws are silent amid arms and do not bid one wait for them, since for the man who wants to wait, unjust punishment must be endured before just punishment can be exacted.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: quodsi iuxta inclitum oratorem silent inter arma leges, quanto magis studia scripturarum, quae et librorum multitudine et silentio ac librariorum sedulitate, quodque uel proprium est, securitate et otio dictantium indigent!
reuse.text_original: quodsi iuxta inclitum oratorem silent inter arma leges, quanto magis studia scripturarum, quae et librorum multitudine et silentio ac librariorum sedulitate, quodque uel proprium est, securitate et otio dictantium indigent!
reuse.text_english: But if, according to the famous orator, the laws are silent amid arms, how much more do studies of the Scriptures, which need both a multitude of books and silence and the diligence of copyists, and, what is their special requirement, the safety and leisure of those dictating!
